anomalies.impact: A device the intended design deliberately leaves disconnected is now an active load on the +5V rail and on the main I2C bus. It draws quiescent current and presents an uncommanded I2C slave that firmware never initializes or reads, which can load/disturb the shared I2C bus and contradicts the documented non-implementation of the LiDAR.
